critique: The render now strongly reads as Rising Bubbles: clean cyan/teal-to-blue circular particles against black, with clear size variation and visible upward turnover between t1 and t4. The firmer silhouettes are a substantial improvement. It is still slightly more populated and scale-heavy than a composed thumbnail-like bubble stream, particularly from the large cropped edge bubbles and several medium overlaps. Edges retain a mild glow/soft halo rather than fully crisp bubble discs.

suggestions.why: Lower the simultaneous particle count so the frame reads as a deliberate stream of separate bubbles instead of a broadly scattered field.
Reduce the oversized foreground and edge-cropped discs while preserving the existing scale variation.
Tighten the remaining soft halo so individual particles retain cleaner, more legible bubble-disc edges.
